name: Agentic AI protocols
description: Protocols and vocabulary for AI agents consuming the web.

hasDefinedTerm.name: MCP
hasDefinedTerm.description: Standardizes how an AI host discovers tools, resources, and prompts from external systems, so each integration is not custom-built per client.

hasDefinedTerm.name: WebMCP
hasDefinedTerm.description: Lets a website declare structured tool APIs in-page through browser-mediated capabilities, reducing brittle DOM automation. A W3C community proposal.

hasDefinedTerm.name: A2A
hasDefinedTerm.description: Standardizes capability discovery, task lifecycle, and cross-agent messaging so agents interoperate regardless of vendor stack.

hasDefinedTerm.name: UCP
hasDefinedTerm.description: Standardizes commerce capabilities and negotiation so platforms, merchants, and payment handlers can transact in agentic interfaces.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ACP
hasDefinedTerm.description: An overloaded acronym. Confirm whether a source means the commerce protocol or the agent-communication one before implementing.

hasDefinedTerm.name: NLWeb
hasDefinedTerm.description: Turns a site into a natural-language queryable endpoint. Agents post a question and receive structured JSON instead of scraping HTML. Every NLWeb instance is also an MCP server.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AP2
hasDefinedTerm.description: An agent payments protocol, designed to sit alongside A2A and MCP in commerce flows.

hasDefinedTerm.name: agentic commerce
hasDefinedTerm.description: Purchases discovered, negotiated, or completed by an AI agent acting for a person.

hasDefinedTerm.name: browser agent
hasDefinedTerm.description: An AI agent that navigates and acts on websites through a real browser session.

hasDefinedTerm.name: tool use
hasDefinedTerm.description: A model invoking an external function or API rather than answering from its own parameters.

hasDefinedTerm.name: agent card
hasDefinedTerm.description: A machine-readable description of an agent's capabilities, used for discovery in A2A.

hasDefinedTerm.name: capability discovery
hasDefinedTerm.description: How one system learns what another can do before calling it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: MCP server
hasDefinedTerm.description: A service exposing tools and resources to AI hosts over the Model Context Protocol.

hasDefinedTerm.name: MCP client
hasDefinedTerm.description: The application connecting a model to MCP servers and mediating tool calls.

hasDefinedTerm.name: agents.json
hasDefinedTerm.description: A proposed manifest describing a site's APIs and workflows so agents can discover and execute them.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Web Bot Auth
hasDefinedTerm.description: A proposal for cryptographically identifying legitimate bots to the sites they visit.

hasDefinedTerm.name: x402
hasDefinedTerm.description: A proposal reviving the HTTP 402 status code for machine-to-machine payment flows.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AGENTS.md
hasDefinedTerm.description: A repository convention giving coding agents project-specific instructions.

hasDefinedTerm.name: autonomous agent
hasDefinedTerm.description: A system that plans and executes multi-step tasks toward a goal with limited human input.

hasDefinedTerm.name: human in the loop
hasDefinedTerm.description: Requiring human approval at defined points in an otherwise automated process.

hasDefinedTerm.name: agent orchestration
hasDefinedTerm.description: Coordinating multiple specialised agents on parts of one task.

hasDefinedTerm.name: structured output
hasDefinedTerm.description: Constraining a model's response to a schema so downstream systems can parse it reliably.

hasDefinedTerm.name: context window
hasDefinedTerm.description: The amount of text a model can consider at once, spanning input and output.

hasDefinedTerm.name: prompt injection
hasDefinedTerm.description: An attack embedding instructions in content a model reads, hijacking its behaviour.

hasDefinedTerm.name: machine-readable
hasDefinedTerm.description: Structured so a program can parse meaning without inference. The prerequisite for agent consumption.
